videos.why: The answer is a direction on the map (the west wind carrying factory smoke east), shown step by step on one city plan, and the first frame (a city split green and grey with a question mark) asks the question without giving it away.
strengths: Map-native answer: the wind across the city
Question title, answer held back until the wind
Sourced payoff: up to 20% of the 2011 split
risks: The first figure only arrives at about 15 s
The city is a drawn plan, not a real named city

videos.why: A universal what-if with a clear payoff (whole countries like the Maldives and Tuvalu gone, the sea about 58 m higher), but the world-from-space shots are sparser than the city Short, and it needed three QA rounds.
strengths: Names Antarctica and asks which countries vanish
Turn: whole island nations wiped off the map
Pick-one ending loops into the first frame
risks: Wide world shots with small flooded areas read weakly on a phone
Its one figure arrives only at the payoff (about 52 s)
